meta.name: prisma-client-api
meta.description: Prisma Client API reference covering model queries, filters, operators, and client methods. Use when writing database queries, using CRUD operations, filtering data, or configuring Prisma Client. Triggers on "prisma query", "findMany", "create", "update", "delete", "$transaction".

copy.tagline: 查询和操作数据库记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要经常查询和修改数据库中的数据。
copy.tagline_en: Look up database query patterns with Prisma
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write database queries and update records.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在回答 Prisma 数据库操作问题时，会按照官方 API 参考给出查询、增删改、筛选、事务等写法和代码示例。
howto.when: 当你说出 “prisma query”、“findMany” 等关键词，或要求编写数据库查询、进行增删改查、筛选数据时触发。

say.text: 用 findMany 查询所有管理员，按创建时间倒序。
写一个事务，同时创建用户和一篇帖子。
say.note: Claude 会展示 $transaction 的数组写法。

say.text: 用 $queryRaw 执行原生 SQL 查询用户表。
say.note: Claude 会说明 raw query 用法及安全注意。

howto.what_en: After this skill is installed, Claude will consult the Prisma Client API reference when answering database query questions, providing accurate syntax and code examples for CRUD, filtering, transactions, and raw SQL.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like "prisma query", "findMany", or when you ask to write database queries, perform CRUD operations, or filter data.

say_en.text: Use findMany to query all admins, ordered by creation time descending.
say_en.note: Claude will provide code with where and orderBy.

say_en.text: Write a transaction that creates a user and a post together.
say_en.note: Claude will show the $transaction array syntax.

say_en.text: Use $queryRaw to run a raw SQL query on the users table.
say_en.note: Claude will explain raw query usage and safety.
